name: Aisai Nikki
source:
A young woman has needs. But she would never betray her husband...
Keisuke loved his wife Sanae with all his heart. She loved him too. They had a sexless life because of his erectile dysfunction. To satisfy her needs as a woman, he enlisted the help of Ryouichi, thinking only about her sexual well-being. Surely she would enjoy the sex, but not give her heart or true love to another man...
Soon paranoid, he filmed Sanae during her sexual encounters. And what he saw...

translation:
年轻女人也有自己的需求，可她绝不会背叛丈夫……

能美圭介全心全意地爱着妻子早苗，早苗也同样爱他。可是，圭介患有勃起功能障碍，两人一直过着无性生活。为了满足妻子作为女人的需求，他请宫越亮一出手相助，一心只想着让她在性爱中得到满足。他深信，早苗固然会享受性爱，却绝不会把自己的心与真爱交给另一个男人……

不久后，疑神疑鬼的圭介开始拍摄早苗与亮一做爱的过程。而他在画面中看到的东西……
